description: This file defines the 'PayGradeCurrency' class, an ORM entity representing the mapping between pay grades and currencies in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for pay grade, currency type, salary range, and related annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrency
classes.description: Entity class representing the association between a pay grade and a currency, along with salary information, in the HRM system.

methods.name: getCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currency.

methods.name: setCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the currency.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated pay grade.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade entity associated with this record.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType entity associated with this record.
